audit.whatIsWrong: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is repeated across tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, report[9].t — that ability does not exist in Hwei's kit. His abilities are Subject: Disaster (Q), Subject: Serenity (W), Subject: Torment (E), Spiraling Despair (R); the CC-carrying spell is Subject: Torment (E). breakdown.cooldowns also has no digit, and the brief's missing-interaction flags Subject: Serenity (W)'s shield absorbing burst is never mentioned.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name shipped to a paying reader across nine fields is worse than a template — it actively misleads which button to track.
audit.corrected: Replace every instance of 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' with 'Subject: Torment (E)', cite its real cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s), and add the Subject: Serenity (W) shield-absorbs-burst interaction.
